QuestInfo.name: Danika's Request
QuestInfo.0: The Black Mage's curse is freezing you along with the town of #m101050000#. You must seal the town away before the curse spreads to the outside world. Talk to #b#p1033101#, the Elder of War#k, first.
QuestInfo.1: #p1033101# warns that the #o9300422#s outside of town could disrupt the magic needed to seal the town away. She thinks you should eliminate the\n#o9300422#s before you do anything else.\r\n#o9300422#s#r #a240011##k
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated the #o9300422#s. It's time to seal the town!

0.0: Your Highness! Before you seal the town, please eliminate the #o9300422#s. I'm worried they'll disrupt the ritual, and the seal won't hold.
0.1: If you can eliminate #r10#k #r#o9300422#s#k, you should be able to complete the seal safely. We're counting on you, Your Highness!

yes.0: I hope I didn't fail you as an Elder of War... I know you just faced the Black Mage, Your Highness, but I don't have the strength left to help you... I'm sorry.

no.0: I know that #o9300422#s are beneath you, Your Highness, but they're still some pretty strong monsters. I don't think anyone else can take care of them right now.

1.0: The village is so quiet now. It's as if everyone's turned in for the night. But when will we ever wake up...?
1.1: I can't hold on any longer. I'm going to sleep now... Goodnight, Your Highness...

mob.0: Are the #r#o9300422#s#k still there, Your Highness? We don't have much time left...
